packages.label: יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהַלֵּב
packages.reason: ישראל, לבא, and לבא דכל עלמא share a single essential nature: Israel collectively IS the heart of the world. The Rebbe cites the Zohar (Pinchas 221b): 'ישראל הם לבא דכל עלמא.' The two nodes לבא and לבא דכל עלמא are two expressions of the same identity — the first names the organ, the second names its cosmic scope. ישראל is the node that carries both. All three form a single bechina cluster: they are not three different things connected causally, but one reality described from three angles. The heart-nature of Israel means they burn (or fail to burn) for God, they are the living fire of the world, and their capacity to burn depends on the leaders removing the עפרוריות from them.

packages.label: מַנְהִיגֵי הַדּוֹר וְהָרוּחַ
packages.label_en: Leaders of the Generation and the Wind
packages.reason: מנהיגי הדור and רוח share the essential nature of the life-giving breath/spirit. The Rebbe states explicitly: 'מנהיגי הדור הם בחינת רוח, כמו שכתוב: איש אשר רוח בו — שיודע לילך נגד רוחו של כל אחד.' The leader's defining quality is that he IS wind — he knows how to move according to each person's spirit, to blow across the heart and reignite its fire. This is not cause-and-effect (the leader does not produce wind); rather, the leader IS a bechina of wind, they share the same essential nature: movement, breath, the animating invisible force that goes against and with each person's inner direction. This package is the good mirror to Package 3 (the destructive storm-wind), and it connects by eitza to Package 1 (the leaders blow on Israel's heart).

packages.label: עַפְרוּרִיּוּת וּמָרָה שְׁחוֹרָה
packages.reason: עפרוריות and מרה שחורה share the essential nature of spiritual suffocation — the substance that falls on the heart and separates the fire-parts so the person can no longer burn for God. The proof text explicitly equates them: 'לנפח מהם העפרוריות, דהינו מרה שחורה שנופל עליהם' — עפרוריות IS מרה שחורה, the 'that is' (דהינו) signals direct bechina identity. Physiologically, the parallel is to dust falling on a candle-flame, causing its fire-particles to separate and the flame to go out. Spiritually, melancholy is precisely that dust: it separates the inner fire of Israel's soul. Both are expressions of the same reality: the particulate-matter that smothers inner fire. This is the primary evil force the Torah addresses. The wicked (ערב רב) who fall upon Israel are also a bechina of עפרוריות (see additions file).

packages.label: רוּחַ סְעָרָה וּבְעִירָה חוּץ מִן הַמִּדָּה
packages.reason: רוח סערה and כשרואה אדם שבוער ביותר חוץ מהמדה share the essential nature of destructive excess — the force that inflames beyond the proper measure. The proof text: 'כשמנשב רוח סערה, אזי הוא מבעיר האש מאד חוץ מן המדה. כמוכן לפעמים יש שמנשב בהאדם בחינת רוח סערה, ומבעירו ביותר חוץ מן המדה.' The sign that a person has been struck by רוח סערה is precisely that they burn beyond measure — so the burning-beyond-measure IS the bechina of רוח סערה in the human domain. This is not the extinguishing force (Package 3) but its opposite: destructive over-ignition, the storm that shatters instead of nourishing. The Rebbe frames this as הריסה (breaking/destruction), citing 'פן יהרסו לעלות אל ה'' — the forbidden attempt to ascend beyond one's level. Elijah could ride and subdue these fiery horses. This package is the evil mirror to Package 2 (good measured wind vs. destructive unmeasured storm).
nodes: כשרואה אדם שבוער ביותר חוץ מהמדה
